preservation_units: Joel used to preach Buddhist enlightenment heavily and later concluded that many people use spiritual freedom to get above childhood trauma or unwanted character material; this is spiritual bypassing
bypassing can split spiritual identity from buried trauma that continues running behavior underneath; seekers/gurus can show the split; Dalai Lama example/link remains
food-bank analogy: both adult and baby starving is understandable; after food becomes available, consuming it while baby remains starving is the unforgivable contrast
people can fail to share spiritual love/freedom with the inner child because they do not experience the child as real; realizing the child is there changes the response

bypassing is not stupidity/craziness; Joel did it too until learning/experiencing the inner child; inner-child work initially sounded silly and later felt directly real/embodied rather than an escape hatch
therapy can also become endless wound-management; spirituality opened a larger horizon of love/happiness beyond conditions and life story

not everyone needs the same spiritual depth; for some ordinary love/meaning is enough, while for others ordinary life/conditional love feel radically insufficient and a deeper possibility becomes central
borrowed adulthood can involve initially seeking an external adult/helper; this can be healthy, but the helper must not keep the adult role
spiritual practice can change relation to pain but cannot substitute for practical protection/action in actual danger or material problems; turning danger into merely a story fails the child
no-self teachings can arrive too early when a person never developed permission to know their own wants/beliefs/refusals; enough selfhood may need to form before loosening it
a helper may identify blind spots or model adult functioning but does not receive final authority over Joel/the reader's life; Pema Chodron quote about weaning dependency/growing up remains
disagreement with a helper is not automatic resistance; helper/method/goal can be wrong or mismatched and a good helper can examine disagreement without making it prove their theory
core line/function: Borrow adulthood. Do not surrender it. A good helper gradually returns the role/life to you
Joel was well-loved but depressed from age 12 to 26 and cried nightly from feeling the pain of the world; loving-kindness meditation healed that depression almost instantly in his experience
love was already underneath from parents, Buddhist teachings, and loveyhuasca; meditation gave that love somewhere to land

meditation still did not reach all inner-child material, especially attachment to women; self-directed inner-child therapy initially felt imaginary; San Pedro cactus, CBD tea, sublingual mapacho opened it and therapist work deepened it
